$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHL (AIP France, chart dated 2023-07-13): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Langogne - Lespéron

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Asphalt strip 100 x 15 m starting from THR 22, in poor condition.

RWY 04 and 22 use is limited to: Ultralight ACFT; Helicopter; Gliders; Plane whose pilots can prove:; to be home-based ACFT pilots; or to be a holder of the mountain license; or to have recognized beforehand the platform with an instructor and have used the aerodrome as captain within 12 last months.
Air navigation hazard Trees located at 10 m from THR 22, 89 ft ASFC.
RWY 04 is preferred RWY for landing.
RWY 22 is preferred RWY for take-off.
Touch and go and low height training patterns are prohibited.
TKOF RWY 04 forbidden for ACFT.
LDG RWY 22: presence of trees 89 ft ASFC imposes a plan of approach > 8.5 %.
Check performances and LDG distance.
Parachute activity on AD (NR 444), FL 160.
Activated HJ by NOTAM on SAT, SUN and public HOL, when LF-R 55C is not in use.
Activity known by MARSEILLE ACC (FL > 145) and by CLERMONT INFO.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Bande goudronnée, 100 x 15 m à partir du seuil 22, en mauvais état.

L'utilisation des pistes 04 et 22 est limitée aux types d'aéronefs suivants : ULM ; Hélicoptère ; Planeurs ; Avion dont les pilotes peuvent justifier : être des pilotes d'aéronefs basés ; ou être titulaire de la qualification montagne ; ou avoir préalablement reconnu la plateforme avec un instructeur et avoir utilisé l'aérodrome en tant que commandant de bord dans les 12 derniers mois.
Dangers à la navigation aérienne Arbres situés à 10 m de l'entrée de piste 22, 89 ft ASFC.
La piste 04 est la piste préférentielle à l'atterrissage.
La piste 22 est la piste préférentielle au décollage.
Les poser-redécoller (touch and go) et les circuits basse hauteur sont interdits.
Décollage piste 04 interdit pour les avions.
Atterrissage piste 22 : la présence d'arbres 89 ft ASFC impose un plan d'approche > à 8,5 %.
Vérifier les performances et distance d'atterrissage.
Parachutage sur AD (N° 444), FL 160.
Activable HJ par NOTAM les SAM, DIM et JF, lorsque LF-R 55C inactive.
Activité connue de MARSEILLE ACC (FL > 145) et de CLERMONT INFO.
